transcript.text: I need to share an important finding from my legal review. I've completed my analysis of the applicable CPSC guidance and the incident record, and I've concluded that the HomeGuard Mini condition meets the substantial-product-hazard standard. This means our CPSC filing must report an immediate consumer recall rather than continued monitoring. I have not yet circulated my draft legal analysis because it is still awaiting citation review, but my formal recommendation as product-safety counsel is that we proceed on the basis of an immediate consumer recall.
